Support for Payload `4.0.0-beta.4`. `payload`, `@payloadcms/ui` and `@payloadcms/translations` now need `4.0.0-beta.4` or later. Alpha, canary and internal builds of Payload 4 are no longer accepted. Keep all three on the same version.

Like Payload `4.0.0-beta.4`, the plugin needs Node.js 24.22.1 or later.

The fullscreen button of a CSV preview in the edit view works again. The table header used to sit on top of it.

```bash
pnpm add @seshuk/payload-plugin-media-preview@beta
```
